entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The case is finally closed. There are no[n]shackles on you anymore.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We changed the heart of someone huge[n]like the next prime minister. There's no[n]better finale than that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This may be the opportune time to end[n]our deal.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm sure you'll be fine now. You can[n]manage without me being with you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't worry. I won't leave immediately.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But if I just stay here, I won't recall[n]anything...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm a bit envious of you. Here I am...[n]Still haven't found anything about[n]myself...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If only I could find out what's in[n]the depths of Mementos...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Let's go to sleep. You must be tired.
